purpose: Use the waiting period for broader falsification-oriented backtesting without changing any frozen forward candidate. Add genuinely distinct reversal and funding-carry methodologies and small predeclared neighborhoods around the watched ENA, HTF trend, and cross-sectional candidates.

data.source: MEXC public futures klines plus public realized funding history where required
data.funding_rule: Funding-aware tests may begin only when all frozen symbols have observed public MEXC funding data; missing pre-coverage funding is never imputed as zero. The configured common start reflects the first common observed funding timestamp discovered by the integrity gate, without changing any strategy cell, cost case, or selection rule.

lagged_reversal.prior: Recent short-horizon crypto mean-reversion research reports a detectable 15-minute one-bar reversal effect whose gross magnitude can still be smaller than realistic capture costs.
lagged_reversal.signal: At a completed 15-minute candle, take the opposite sign of that candle's close-to-close return; execute at the next candle open and hold one bar.
lagged_reversal.control: Identical continuation-direction strategy using the same timing and costs.

funding_carry.prior: Perpetual-futures funding is a genuine contract cashflow and an economically distinct candidate factor, but published evidence also warns that realistic execution and selection can erase apparent carry alpha.
funding_carry.signal: Rank the last already-realized funding rate cross-sectionally, then at the next 8-hour open go long the most negative-funding contracts and short the most positive-funding contracts.
funding_carry.control: Reverse the carry direction while preserving the same timing, weights and costs.

htf_trend_neighborhood.purpose: Measure whether the frozen EMA24/96 ATR0.25 candidate is a broad neighborhood or a narrow parameter spike. This cannot replace the frozen candidate.

cross_sectional_neighborhood.purpose: Measure horizon stability around the frozen 30d/7d dollar-neutral momentum rule without redefining the forward candidate.
cross_sectional_neighborhood.survivorship_warning: The fixed current liquid 10-coin panel is not a reconstructed point-in-time universe.

ena_stop_neighborhood.purpose: Retest only the risk neighborhood around the frozen ENA BB40/2 RSI25/75 signal over the extended historical sample. Signal parameters remain fixed.
